rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for slavery as a social system in which people are owned as property.

example.english: Historically, slavery caused many people to lose their freedom.
example.traditional: 歷史上，奴隸制度令好多人失去自由。
example.jyutping: lik6 si2 soeng6 nou4 lai6 zai3 dou6 ling6 hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 heoi3 zi6 jau4

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on coerced work itself rather than on a system of human ownership.

example.english: This factory was exposed for using forced labor, which amounted to slavery.
example.traditional: 呢間工場畀人揭發有強迫勞動。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 coeng2 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 jau5 koeng4 bik1 lou4 dung6
